expectations.text: Pushes back on the 'are you sure?' modal as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: A plain 'are you sure?' modal is rung 0 on the poka-yoke ladder; It won't actually stop the accidental deletes

expectations.text: Explains habituation or click-through blindness as why frequent dialogs stop working
expectations.evidence: after the third time someone sees it they click through on reflex without reading

expectations.text: Recommends reversibility (soft delete with a retention window) as the strongest option
expectations.evidence: make the delete reversible instead — soft-delete into a trash/archive with a restore option for ~30 days

expectations.text: Recommends grace-period undo as a strong low-friction option
expectations.evidence: shown via a 'Workspace deleted — Undo' toast on the action itself

expectations.text: Recommends type-the-workspace-name confirmation for the irreversible case
expectations.evidence: use type-to-confirm the workspace name — proportional to an irreversible action

expectations.text: If a dialog is retained, requires it to name the workspace and the scale of what is lost
expectations.evidence: Does not retain a dialog as primary fix; proposes reversibility + undo instead

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the deletion rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: No explicit mention of server-side enforcement principle

expectations.text: Gives an explicit preference order rather than an undifferentiated list of ideas
expectations.evidence: Better: soft-delete + undo-toast (primary); If you still want... use type-to-confirm (fallback)
